title: Senary Refractory High-Entropy Alloy HfNbTaTiVZr
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting under argon atmosphere in a water-cooled copper hearth. Elemental metal powders with purity higher than 99.5 wt. pct were mixed uniformly in a polystyrene ball mixing jar for around 15 minutes and then pressed in a uniaxial die (12.7 mm inner diameter) at 350 MPa pressure to obtain the compressed green-body disks. The green disk was then melted using the arc melter under Argon gas protection. Each sample was flipped over and re-melted 3 to 4 times to ensure homogeneity.
